Name: Ian's Closet - Seasonal Outfits
Author: x3n3as
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/D0VVVZKG/Ians-Outfits.png[/img]

Here's another outfit for Ian, an NPC from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7286]Ridgeside Village[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url].

I've said it before, but the content and manifest on these mods are based off [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]Zoedoll[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9559]Unofficial Ridgeside Village Seasonal Outfits - Alissa[/url].

This one, I've got to say, took much longer than it should have, considering how little variation
his outfits have.

He doesn't strike me as a fashionista, but the man deserved some more clothes anyway.

Anyway, without much further ado, here are the added outfits for Ian:

[img]https://i.postimg.cc/tTpPBdsn/ian-outfits.png[/img]﻿
I had a lot of fun, even it took me forever. Hercules just fits, doesn't it?[s]

[/s]Anyway, thank you for downloading, reading thus far, and please please [b]please[/b], don't forget to endorse [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/7439530]Zoedoll[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/66167516]Rafseazz[/url]!
